luci-theme-design-x.description: Read-only system metrics for the design-x LuCI theme dashboard. All read methods are pure reads of /sys/class/, /proc/, or via iwinfo ubus calls — no writes, no exec of user input. Step 242 (Round 46) adds write methods for the Clients-card Block button: block-mac / unblock-mac manage a kernel-side nftables set, and list-blocks reports current state. Write methods accept a single MAC string, validated server-side against `^[0-9a-fA-F]{2}(:[0-9a-fA-F]{2}){5}$` before any kernel call — same client-side-sanitize discipline as Step 153 host-rename. Replaces the legacy unauthenticated /cgi-bin/design/* endpoints (Round 42 Step 163, Codex P1-6).
